summary: Paired tension-and-shape imaging exists in the BioImage Archive for human embryo blastomeres (S-BIAD915, micropipette surface-tension mapping with time-lapse, CC BY 4.0) and mouse fibroblast cortical mechanics (S-BIAD2611), and amoeboid shape-change movies exist for Dictyostelium, but no repository dataset measures cortical tension of a free-living amoeba while varying the contacting medium; the classic Amoeba interfacial-tension experiments remain in paper tables.
next_step: Treat cortical tension as the modern referent, pre-register a tension-vs-outline-curvature analysis on S-BIAD915 (and its supplementary tension table), and compile Dictyostelium micropipette-aspiration tension values from the literature for the amoeboid case; a medium-dependence test needs new data.
obstacles_confirmed: Paired tension-and-shape series sit in paper supplements rather than in the image archives.
Most image datasets lack independent force measurements.
